Subject: Re: Notice: Subprocessor change — introducing CloudStream for logging (Order Form redline attached)

Sabrina / Michael — thanks for the artifacts. I reviewed the Order Form redline and CloudStream materials. A few legal items we need to capture before Redwood can approve:

1) DPA flow-down: the Order Form must explicitly incorporate the DPA annex by reference and require CloudStream to be bound by the same security and breach notification obligations. Please add an explicit sentence in the Order Form (new §4.3.2): "CloudStream LLC shall be bound by the DPA annex and must comply with Audit and Breach notification obligations as set forth in Section 6 of the DPA."

2) Audit & attestations: CloudStream must provide either a SOC2 Type II report or a written compensating controls statement if a report is not available. If a compensating statement is provided, AppBridge must notify Redwood of remediation timelines.

3) Escrow / transition language: we require a limited subcontractor escrow access clause allowing Redwood to retrieve logs for incident forensics for 30 days where AppBridge cannot produce them within 72 hours. Proposed short-form: "If AppBridge fails to produce requested logs for incident response within 72 hours, CloudStream shall provide Redwood with read-only access to the relevant log subset, subject to Redwood's reasonable and documented security controls."

4) Data residency: confirmed that processing is in us-east-1 — add confirmation language to Order Form §4.3.3.

5) Docusign subject: please route the fully-redlined Order Form plus a CloudStream attestation to procurement@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com (Connor and I).

I have attached a one-page legal redline for the MSA/Order Form (legal_redline_msa.docx) that highlights the three insertions above. Please review and confirm acceptance or propose counter-language; if we can get agreement on these five points we will approve the Order Form to proceed.

Deadline: for this quarter's release window we need execution by EOD Friday (2026-07-23). If AppBridge cannot accept the escrow wording we may need an escalation path via the VP of Partnerships.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
